title: Virgin Nerd
paragraphs: “Motoyasu-san…”
“What is it?”
“You love Filolials no matter what form they take, right?”
“Of course!”
What is he talking about? To me, Filolials are beings to be loved regardless of their form.
“Ren and Itsuki are acting all high and mighty… and the Filolials are all focused on Motoyasu-kun!”
“At least there’s no gossip about them!”
“Indeed.”

What are they so smug about? I’m not sure, but I suppose it’s safe to say the elder sister has won this round. Come to think of it, I seem to recall the Filolials mentioning that the Father from the first world made a similar promise.
“If you’re worried about age, then just wait until they reach adulthood. Naofumi, there are quite a few among the ones you’ve protected who feel that way.”
At Ren’s words, Father seemed to lose all strength.
“I don’t understand why Ren and Itsuki are going along with Sadina-san’s strange behavior, but… you’re saying I have to take responsibility, right?”
“If you reject someone who feels as strongly as Imia-san does, it’ll hurt, won’t it?”
“In this world, just being associated with a hero or being a hero’s child is highly valued. So, dreaming of a harem isn’t so far-fetched. Look at King Faubrey.”
“Becoming a pig king is out of the question! Ugh… I’ll do my best to delay this until Imia-chan is truly of age.”
“Oh my, I’ll be watching over you.”
“You’re definitely planning to get involved, aren’t you? With that attitude!”
Father snaps at the elder sister.
But… is it just my imagination, or does Father seem to be enjoying this a little?
“It might not be my place to say this since we encouraged it, but Naofumi-san doesn’t really judge people by appearance, does he?”
“True. Sadina and Larsa can switch to humanoid forms, so most people would be fine with that. But when it comes to beastmen, there are probably those who wouldn’t be able to handle it.”
“Even Takt had a harem, but none of them were beastmen like Imia-san.”
“Ah, right. He even called Imia distasteful…”

Yes, that did happen. But Takt is the kind of person who judges people by their looks. He could never understand Father’s heart. He’s like how I used to be, choosing based solely on appearance. If someone didn’t look good, he’d probably call them disgusting. The fact that he called the mole distasteful is proof enough. As for me, I love Filo-tan no matter what form she takes. I could talk forever about the beauty of Filo-tan in her Filolial form. I love her angelic form too, but her Filolial form perfectly captures her cuteness. More than anything, I love Filo-tan not just for her appearance, but for her heart.
“Maybe it’s a requirement for those chosen as the Shield Hero?”
“Well, considering he’s a hero from a demi-human country, I guess it’s not a problem if they’re humanoid. And Imia isn’t fully a mole, after all.”
“Um…”
Father looks like he wants to say something.
“Gaelion wants to loop…”
At that moment, the rival mutters softly, glaring resentfully at the elder sister.
“By that logic, shouldn’t Gaelion-san be able to join the gatherings too? He’s a dragon, after all.”
“No, Gaelion-chan is still a child! Even if Imia-chan is considered an adult!”
“Gaelion wants to loop…”
“Hey… lately, Gaelion’s been saying nothing but that…”
The assistant looks troubled as they protest to us.
Is that so? I wasn’t paying attention at all since I couldn’t care less about the rival.
“Windia, do you understand the recent changes?”
“Yeah. It’s about the Shield Hero getting together with Sadina-san and mating with Larsa-san at night, right?”
“Ugh… Hearing that from Windia-chan is a shock…”
“Also, saying ‘mating’ makes it sound way too raw.”
“She was raised by a dragon, after all. That’s just how Windia is.”
The assistant’s perspective seems to be based on monsters. She doesn’t use human-like terms like s**.

“Do you want to include Gaelion in that? Well, Gaelion has been trying to seduce the Shield Hero all along. Even when we went to challenge her father, she said, ‘Let him be apart from Gaelion for a while so he can understand the loneliness! Love is all about strategy!’”
“Yeah, she did say that.”
“She really said that…?”
“Gaelion wants to loop…”
There it is again.
Is that her cry or something? And her eyes look lifeless.
“It’s natural for a strong male to surround himself with females. If Imia-chan likes the Shield Hero, I think it’s fine, and if Gaelion wants that, isn’t it okay?”
“That’s pretty cold.”
“Her instincts are still wild. I guess we’ll have to teach her the manners to bring her closer to human behavior.”
“That’s Naofumi-san and Sadina-san’s job, isn’t it?”
“I agree with that part.”
“Oh my.”
“Gaelion wants to loop…”
The elder sister laughs joyfully. But this rival has been looping and looping nonstop for a while now.
“Based on everything that’s happened so far, I’m getting the feeling that Gaelion thinks Naofumi-san was stolen away by Sadina-san, right?”
“Stolen…? I wasn’t dating Gaelion-chan, though.”
“It’s stolen!”
The rival stomps her feet as she declares this. Suddenly snapping… well, that’s a dragon for you.
“I was so close to conquering Naofumi, but that woman intercepted me at the last moment!”
With a dramatic point, the rival directs her finger at the elder sister.
“It was a mistake! Gaelion’s mistake was focusing her rivalry on the Filolial! I never realized Naofumi actually prefers older women who protect him!”
“What do you mean by ‘Filolial’!?”
Depending on the answer, I’ll have to kill her!
“Motoyasu, calm down!”
“Yes, calm down. She’s just confused right now!”
As I gripped my spear tightly, Ren and Itsuki held me back.
Tch! They’re getting in my way.
“Oh my? I’m pretty sure Gaelion-chan can transform into a human, right? Then why not just match her transformation to be about my age? Let’s all enjoy the feast of lust together.”
“That’s not—”
“I don’t want to!”
The rival forcefully slapped away the elder sister’s outstretched hand.
Oh?
“Gaelion wanted to be Naofumi’s first! After that, anything would have been fine!”
“How should I put this… I’ve heard of the term ‘virgin fetish,’ but this is the first time I’ve seen someone obsessed with taking someone’s virginity.”
“In stories, there are dragons that desire virgins just to devour them, but a dragon that desires a man’s first time… what a nasty dragon.”
“Um…”

This is becoming quite a bizarre situation. If it were the Father from the first world, his patience would have snapped by now. Probably around the time the elder sister started talking about the feast.
“Naofumi has already lost his virginity to that woman over there. Gaelion can’t make him hers anymore… It’s over… Oooooooohhhh…”
Like a waterfall, the rival shed tears while stomping her feet.
Hah! I won’t let things go the way the rival wants!
Isn’t this great, Father? As I flashed a victorious smile and gave a thumbs-up, Father looked completely drained.
“So, to claim Naofumi-san’s virginity, looping is the only way left.”
“Oooooooohhhh…”
The rival nodded with tears streaming down.
“But the only one who can accurately recognize the loops is Motoyasu-san, and even if you looped, Gaelion-san wouldn’t be able to perceive it, right?”
“Besides, Motoyasu hates dragons. I doubt he’d tell you anything.”
At that, the rival wiped her tears and then glared at us with a determined look as she took a step forward.
“It’s fine! Gaelion has already found a way to solve that problem!”
“What?”
“What do you mean?”
The rival puffed out her chest proudly, her eyes still teary but full of confidence.
What is she planning now!?
“Anticipating something like this, Gaelion kept in constant contact with the Spear Hero’s spear to ensure everything wouldn’t be undone.”
“Huh? When did she have time to do that!? This is the first I’m hearing of it!”
“Recently, Gaelion endured the Filolial stench while the Spear Hero was sleeping and kept working hard on it!”
“What did you say!?”
What’s this? My heart rate is steadily rising, and cold sweat won’t stop running down my back.
What’s happening here!?
“Wh-what exactly did you do…?”
Itsuki timidly asked the rival.
“Hehehe. Gaelion transferred her memories into the Spear Hero’s spear so she could ride along with the loops. With the power of the Dragon Emperor, accessing the spear wasn’t impossible.”
“What!?”
The rival proudly declared something outrageous!
What kind of vile, underhanded scheme is this!? A dragon’s memories… inside my spear!?
“If there’s a dragon egg near the spear after a loop, it can access it and draw Gaelion’s soul, inheriting her memories as they are. It’s perfect!”
After saying that, the rival gazed into the distance with a dreamy expression.
Chapter 752 – Sourness
“This method was inspired by what the previous Gaelion did as a last resort, something the Spear Hero mentioned before.”
“Huh?”
Father furrowed his brows, voicing my thoughts.
I felt an ominous, filthy sensation crawling all over me!

“With just a fragment of the Dragon Emperor’s power, the previous Gaelion could barely store her memories in the spear… Memories of when a savage adventurer invaded the nest, when big sis was crying, and how Naofumi saved her… those days were vividly preserved…”
The rival spoke dreamily. I want to punch her so badly…

“The previous Gaelion, fearing that these feelings might be lost, poured her hidden emotions into the spear, breached a powerful barrier, and secured space for her memories. She entrusted her will to the current Gaelion, who pursued the same goal, and it was accomplished!”
“Uwaaahhh! Disgusting! Die already!”
The rival’s memories are inside my spear!?
Such a vile and revolting thing is impossible to comprehend!
“Mo-Motoyasu-kun, calm down!”
Father restrained me from behind.
But there’s no way I can hold back!
“Calm down, Motoyasu!”
“Oh dear…”
The elder sister sounded troubled, but I’m the one who’s truly troubled here.
Something so filthy is inside my spear!
How do I get rid of something so disgusting!?
“Gaelion inherited the previous Gaelion’s memories and grew to love Naofumi even more, only to be treated like this! That’s why she wants to loop again!”
“Die, you fiend!”
“Even if I’m a fiend, Gaelion loves Naofumi!”
“But… in a way, this might be an opportunity.”
“What!?”
Father asked Itsuki while still restraining me.
“Because Motoyasu-san is terrible at explaining things and tends to forget important stuff. Wouldn’t Gaelion be able to provide clearer explanations?”
“That’s a piece of cake! Leave it to me!”
“But… it’s Gaelion, you know?”
Ren interjected.
Exactly.
This damn dragon is going to explain things on my behalf to Father and the others?
I can’t help but scoff at that!
“Do you have a problem with that!? With a fragment of the Dragon Emperor’s power, Gaelion can even achieve a class-up beyond the limit!”
Then, the rival turned to the assistant, who was staring blankly, and waved her hand as if trying to act elegant.

“That’s the plan. Big sis will spend the next loop living leisurely with Dad in the nest and territory, while Gaelion will join Naofumi and the others in the battle for world peace. That’s how it’s going to be!”
I can’t help but feel like she’s mocking us.
More than that, why is she being so reckless?
“Hmm… It’s nice that I can be with Dad, but something doesn’t sit right.”
The assistant frowned and glared at the rival.
“How should I put it… It feels like her true colors are showing… It does seem convenient, though.”

“No, it’s not just about her memory and knowledge. Since it’s filtered through Gaelion’s perspective, wouldn’t it be difficult to grasp? Besides, knowing her, Gaelion will probably demand something from Naofumi in return.”
“Ah, like offering future knowledge in exchange for his virginity, or something along those lines.”
“Of course! Gaelion won’t give up! Just like the Spear Hero!”
“Ugh…”
Father was also visibly disturbed. I was in even greater despair.
I want to kill this thing right now! No, wait… killing her wouldn’t work.
Then, what should I do? That’s it.

The only way for me to prevent the rival from showing up in the next loop is to make sure Father gets involved with someone before she appears! I can’t afford not to recruit the assistant and the weakest Dragon Emperor in the next loop! But it took me a long time to reach this conclusion as I continued to be confused.
“Lord Motoyasu, please calm down!”
Yuki-chan, Kou, and the Filolials finally managed to calm me down.
But how am I supposed to save the world with this filthy spear?
“For now, if there’s another loop, Naofumi’s suffering is guaranteed, isn’t it?”
“Good or bad… I’m not sure.”
“Next time, I’ll definitely win over Naofumi with a big-breasted older sister character!”

The rival’s determined words echoed in my mind. As my spirit took tremendous damage, the days of peaceful busyness passed. Even in the Nosferatu Great Forest, Filo-tan was nowhere to be found. The Phoenix was easily defeated by Father and the others, and the Kirin was similarly dealt with in a single day. Then, the waves resumed. Under the guidance of the elder sister, I continued raising slaves and Filolials, but still, Filo-tan could not be found.

When even the knowledge from the first world had become unreliable, I started calculating the days and realized… aren’t we approaching the same point as in the first world? However, unlike the first world, there are almost no individuals chosen by the Seven Star Weapons. Thanks to Father and the others raising soldiers and Filolials of various countries to their limits, we were now able to easily quell the waves.
“Looks like Motoyasu-kun has exhausted all his future knowledge.”
“Indeed.”
“That’s a relief.”
“At least we won’t be tossed around by Motoyasu’s knowledge anymore.”
And yet… something feels off. The further we progress, the more my memories become hazy. I remember something about going to the sanctuary of the Filolials… but it’s all so vague.

How did we get there? By the way, the wave is set to occur in just a few hours. It’s the last wave I can remember… and I’m worried. Currently, we are resting in the hero’s quarters prepared by Faubrey.
“Naofumi-chan, can you give me something for nausea? I drank too much. I’m feeling a little sick.”
“Sadina-san, you were drinking quite a lot with Larsa last night.”
The slightly drunk elder sister leaned against Father as she spoke.
“Ugh… I feel sick…”

Panda seemed to be in the same state. She went off to throw up. By the way, Panda was all dressed up and had been getting compliments from the village slaves, calling her cute. It seems Father and the elder sister have completely finished her transformation.
“Ahh, I feel like eating that sour thing you made the other day. It feels like it helps with hangovers.”
“Got it. I’ll get it ready right away. We have a wave coming up today, so we need to be ready to fight properly.”

Father began preparing the food. We’re in an environment where Father cooks for us every day using the fresh ingredients provided by Faubrey. At that moment, Ren and Itsuki started whispering while watching Panda and the elder sister. Then, they cautiously called out to Panda.
“Hey.”
“Hmm? What is it?”
“You’ve been getting hangover remedies from Naofumi for days now… but doesn’t that mean…”
“Even Sadina-san, who can usually handle her liquor, right?”
“Ara?”
“Eh? W-What’s that supposed to mean?”
“If you’ve been having drinking parties with Naofumi every night, it’d be strange if nothing happened, wouldn’t it?”
The elder sister touched her cheek, looking a little embarrassed, while Panda gradually turned pale.
“So that’s why you’ve been looking more radiant and gentle lately!”

Panda’s subordinates, whom we hadn’t heard from in a while, started causing a commotion. Well, they had been noisy before, but it hadn’t reached my ears. For some reason, Ren and Itsuki started clapping, and hearing the noise, Éclair, the assistant, the mole, and the others living with us gathered around.
“Congratulations.”
“Congratulations.”
“Congratulations. What are we celebrating?”
“Sadina-san and Larsa-san are expecting.”
“Oh! Is that true? Congratulations!”
“Don’t start celebrating on your own! Ugh, I just have a bad hangover!”
Should I join in? Father looks so happy and embarrassed.
“Congratulations!”
“Stoooop celebrating without permission!”
“Ara? What should we do now, Naofumi-chan?”
“Hmm. I guess Sadina-san and Larsa-san should step back from the front lines and take care of their bodies for now?”
“It’s not certain yet, so it’s fine. Though… nothing’s come, that’s true.”
At that moment, Panda turned even paler.
“Come to think of it, I haven’t had mine either! Could it really be…?”
But Panda quickly regained her composure.
“Tch… If that’s how it is, then I guess there’s no helping it… If it’s a hero’s child, it’s not a bad thing.”
“For now, it’s not confirmed, but what about names?”
“What do you want to do, Sadina-san? Larsa-san?”
“Hmm… Maybe I’ll borrow a name from Raphtalia-chan?”
“That might be nice.”
“I’ll decide when the time comes.”
And so, those peaceful days passed by.
